reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user-controlled input). The ternary condition (7 * 42) - num > 200 evaluates to 188 > 200 = false, so bar = param (line 52). User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest00387') flows directly to bar, then to bar.toCharArray() at the response writer (line 54) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. This is a genuine XSS vulnerability.
